reader.requirement: At --std 85 FINAL, written once as the first CONTROL operand (format `FINAL [data-name-1]...`), names the most inclusive control level, which no control data item is associated with: it never breaks during GENERATE, its CH FINAL prints at the first GENERATE, its CF FINAL prints last at TERMINATE, a SUM RESET/CF FINAL accumulates the whole report, and FINAL is a level TYPE CH/CF FINAL may name only when the CONTROL clause names it. The witness covers FINAL plus one data-name only.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel >= 2002 asks the 2023 written-operand uniqueness (SR6) of the CONTROL operands; at 85 ResolveReports calls ScreenControlItemsDistinct (§1985 SR2, resolved items) instead. The FINAL placement screen (COBOL2421) and the FINAL level itself consult no edition

reader.edition-search: Read the CONTROL arm of BindReportDescriptionClauses, ResolveReports' CH/CF level match (ControlFinal -> FindIndex(IsFinal)), DetectBreakLevel (skips IsFinal) and grepped ReportWriter.cs for Edition/DialectBehavior: the four DialectBehavior arms there do not touch FINAL.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (for FINAL; only the operand-uniqueness rule beside it differs)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR4  (3.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: FINAL is model.Controls' IsFinal level; DetectBreakLevel never breaks it and Terminate prints footings minor to major so CF FINAL is last. Diagnostics cite the 2023 clause numbers, which does not change the verdict.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-039: p1nogen (CONTROL FINAL, CH/CF FINAL, INITIATE then TERMINATE with no GENERATE) -> empty report, as §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2 requires (cite OK); p1multi (CONTROLS ARE FINAL WS-A WS-B, CH FINAL, CH WS-A, CF WS-B with SUM and SUM RESET ON FINAL, CF WS-A rolling SUM, CF FINAL) -> CH-F once, CF-B/CF-A at each break, rolling TR 12/15/25/28 never reset by a data-name break, CF-F last with 0028: FINAL never breaks mid-report; p1sumrep (CONTROL FINAL, GENERATE report-name twice) -> CF-F 0010 only; p1ff (CONTROL IS FINAL FINAL) -> COBOL2421 refused; p1rf (RESET ON FINAL with CONTROL IS WS-B) -> COBOL0899 refused (§1985 SUM SR: FINAL in RESET must appear in the CONTROL clause). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR4 'FINAL is used when the most inclusive control group in the report is not associated with a control data-name'. No 2002-only CONTROL form exists to refuse. Diagnostics cite §2023 clause numbers (wording only).
